title: Lumen Reach 0.9.0 -> 0.9.1: guard rails on the rooftop walkway and raised landings
subtitle: Exact poses, private Intel nested, Medium 0.5 scale, core a2d39f9 (main, IPC 0.19); release packages (format 0.7); columns differ only by package.

rows.title: 16 m roof bridge, north edge
rows.caption: 0.9.0: the 1.5 m bridge had no rail on its north edge or ends (16 m drop). 0.9.1: rail along the north edge and both ends.

rows.title: 16 m bridge run, east edge
rows.caption: 0.9.0: open from the facade rooftop to the bridge. 0.9.1: rail from the rooftop corner to the bridge end.

rows.title: 16 m facade rooftop, north edge
rows.caption: 0.9.0: open (an invisible backstop stopped walkers on part of it). 0.9.1: visible rail along the north and east edges.

rows.title: 12 m roof upper landing, west edge
rows.caption: 0.9.0: open to an 8-12 m drop. 0.9.1: west edge and open north end railed.

rows.title: 8 m roof landing, north-west corner
rows.caption: 0.9.0: open on three sides (backstop only on part). 0.9.1: west, north and east edges and the upper ramp crest railed.

rows.title: 8 m hall upper balcony, west edge
rows.caption: 0.9.0: open 8 m drop to the annex. 0.9.1: west edge past the atrium column, south edge and ramp-crest corners railed.

rows.title: Roof bridge at eye height (0.8.1 review view)
rows.caption: The slot beside the ramp top is now closed by a short rail; the walkway itself is unchanged.
